title: Normalized total tensor pullback on actual module complexes
statement: For small sites J and K, a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint L with algebraic inverse-image data F [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence], coefficient ring sheaves R and S, and an arbitrary map c:F(R)→S, let P be ordinary module pullback and Pc its action on cochain complexes. There are an isomorphism j:Pc(R[0])≅S[0] and a natural isomorphism, in both complexes N and M, Pc(N tensor_R M)≅Pc(N) tensor_S Pc(M), for the actual total tensor [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. The inverse right unitor carried through this comparison and tensoring by j is the target inverse right unitor. No flatness, completion, or boundedness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Use the generic module adjunction for the supplied algebraic inverse image and scalar extension, and the canonical ordinary tensor comparison together with its rank-one right-unit normalization.

Construct the total comparison on complexes first for abstract additive monoidal categories, and specialize it once to module sheaves. Its summands are inverse ordinary tensor comparisons; naturality in both complex maps follows summandwise. Module pullback preserves coproducts by its adjunction, so the total comparison is invertible. Package the comparison, its two naturality equations, and unit normalization in TensorPullbackComparison, whose tensor functors and unitors are parameters; concrete localized monoidal structures are checked once.

Transport the ordinary rank-one isomorphism with singleMapHomologicalComplex. For the right-unit equality, cancel the invertible total comparison and the inverse of tensoring by j. Evaluate in degree n, expand the inverse right unitor as its degree-(n,0) insertion, and apply tensor comparison naturality and its ordinary right-unit equation. Prove the component calculation first for abstract additive monoidal categories; specialize it once to module sheaves.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedComplexTensorPullback
    {C D : Type v} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {L : Sheaf J (Type v) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type v)}
    (F : InverseImageData L) (V : Sheaf K (Type v) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type v))
    (adj : L ⊣ V) [PreservesFiniteLimits L]
    {R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{v}} {S : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{v}}
    (c : F.rings.obj R ⟶ S) :
    Nonempty (TensorPullbackComparison ((pull F c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
      (ringedKoszulTensor R) (ringedKoszulTensor S)
      (ringedSiteRingComplex R) (ringedSiteRingComplex S)
      (ringedKoszulRightUnitIso R) (ringedKoszulRightUnitIso S))
